description: Service Broker ops view: database enablement, queue backlog/activation/poison, transmission by service, conversations, endpoint/transport connections, activation counters, forwarding and certificate expiry. Collector: mssql_service_broker. Empty panels usually mean Service Broker is disabled or the profile is not scraped yet.

targets.expr: count(count by (instance, db) (mssql_service_broker_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} == 1 or mssql_service_broker_queue_messages{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} or mssql_service_broker_transmission_messages{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})) or vector(0)

count(mssql_service_broker_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} == 1 and mssql_service_broker_database_accessible{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.description: Inventory from mssql_service_broker_enabled/queues/... Empty until the database inventory query is scraped successfully after collector redeploy.
panels.title: Broker databases (enabled / inventory)

panels.description: Fallback inventory derived from queue/transmission series while enabled inventory is missing or after partial scrape.
panels.title: Broker DBs inferred from queues / transmission (works now)

panels.description: Receive=0 often means poison-message handling disabled the queue. Oldest Msg=-1 means peek failed; 0 means empty. Retention=On can inflate Messages via partition stats.
panels.title: Queue detail (config + backlog + monitor)

targets.expr: sum by (instance, db, schema, queue) (mssql_service_broker_queue_messages{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})
sum by (instance, db, queue) (mssql_service_broker_queue_tasks_waiting{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})

panels.description: status_class=error when transmission_status is non-empty. Use this to find which remote/local service is stuck.
panels.title: Transmission by destination service

panels.description: is_initiator: 1=initiator, 0=target. Negative lifetime remaining means dialog already expired.
panels.title: Conversation endpoints by state / role

panels.description: Empty table usually means no Service Broker endpoint is configured on the instance.
panels.title: Service Broker endpoints

panels.description: Flow-controlled connections indicate transport pressure between broker instances.
panels.title: Broker network connections

panels.description: Scope=_endpoint is the Service Broker endpoint certificate in master. Negative = already expired.
panels.title: Certificate expiry

title: Collector service-broker
